 Specimen preparation 
 Specimen punch for plastics
Hegewald & Peschke offers various specimen punches and cutting presses with extensive accessories for the standard-compliant production of plastic specimens.
With the manual or hydropneumatic cutting presses and the corresponding knives, plastic samples can be produced in accordance with standards.
 Manual toggle presses with round ram
Advantages and features 
Quick and flexible to use 
High pressing force via short press stroke 
Quick and easy height adjustment of the press head via threaded spindle 
Hardened and ground round ram with high-precision ram guide 
Practically maintenance-free 
Suitable for many materials: Elastomers, plastics, textiles, paper, films 
 Toggle press 30 kN
 Hydropneumatic cutting presses
Advantages and features 
Quick and flexible to use 
High pressing force via short press stroke 
Quick and easy height adjustment of the press head via threaded spindle 
Hardened and ground round ram with high-precision ram guide 
Practically maintenance-free 
Suitable for many materials: Elastomers, plastics, textiles, paper, films 
 Hydropneumatic cutting press with two-hand operation
 Accessories for cutting presses
Different cutting devices are installed in the cutting presses depending on the specimen shape and material.
To select the optimum cutting tool in combination with the cutting press, it is advisable to have preliminary tests carried out by Hegewald & Peschke.
Two different cutting tool systems are available: 
Punching knives made of solid steel, eroded 
Super Dumbbell® punching knife 
 1. Punching knives made of solid steel, eroded
The punching knives are manufactured from selected steels and are available in a wide variety of geometries and standards of all kinds, e.g. ISO, DIN, JIS, ASTM, IEC.
Advantages 
Competent steel selection 
Material-specific cutting geometry 
Optional equipment with various sample ejectors and clamping pins 
Customized production in different heights possible 
Also possible as a multicutter 
Outstanding cutting finish 
Optimum cutting results 
Suitable for every type of press, e.g. manual toggle presses and hydropneumatic presses 
 Structure: The punching knives consist of a punching knife, a holder and an ejector.
more
 2. Super Dumbbell® punching knife
The Super Dumbbell punching knife with built-in spring ejector and 5 sets of replacement precision blades is suitable for manual cutting presses.
The precision blades are clamped in a fixture according to the sample shape required by the standard and can be easily replaced if necessary. Each punching knife comes with a built-in ejector as well as 5 sets of replacement blades, replacement screws and the associated tools.
Vorteile 
Hervorragendes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis: „6 Messer zum Preis von einem” (im Lieferumfang sind 5 Ersatzschneiden enthalten) 
Geringe Ersatzteilkosten durch Klingensätze 
Garantie für hochpräzise Prüfkörper sowie zuverlässige und reproduzierbare Testergebnisse 
Geeignet für Elastomere, Kunststoffe u. a. 
Normgerechte Probenkörper z. B. nach ISO, DIN, JIS, ASTM, IEC 
Auswechselbare Präzisionsschneiden 
Japanischer Carbonstahl: ultrahart - extrem scharf - maximale Schnitthaltigkeit 
Einfacher Austausch 
Kein Nachschleifen 
Keine Ausfallzeiten 
Schneidensymmetrie verhindert konkave Querschnittsgeometrie  
Extrem glatte Schnittflächen 
Jederzeit separat erhältlich 
 Structure: The Super Dumbbell punching knives consist of precision blades, clamping device and ejector, mounted on a base plate.
